annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家知识产权局 (China National Intellectual Property Administration)
key_provisions_or_claims: Aims for a more complete IP public service system by 2030
Implement national standards for IP information public services and classify service institutions
Provide tailored IP services for SMEs, strategic science and technology, and innovation clusters
Build cross-departmental IP data governance and high-quality IP datasets
Apply 'AI+' tools such as intelligent search, analysis, Q&A and agents in IP public services
annotation.summary_en: Opinion of China's National Intellectual Property Administration on strengthening the IP public service system by 2030. It covers standardised basic services, tailored services for SMEs and innovation clusters, cross-regional and public-market coordination, and data and 'AI+' applications in IP services. It has no robotics content.
annotation.title_clean: 国家知识产权局关于加强知识产权公共服务体系建设的意见
annotation.title_en: Opinions of the China National Intellectual Property Administration on Strengthening the Construction of the Intellectual Property Public Service System
